title: On the Limits of Observability for Evaluating Coverage in Machine Unlearning
abstract: arXiv:2611.27543v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of any requested subset of training data while preserving utility on the remaining data. Empirical evaluations measure predictive accuracy and infer training-set membership (MIAs) from model outputs or intermediate activations. However, by focusing on selected forget sets, these evaluations can overlook Coverage, the range of requests a method can fulfill. To assess this coverage, we first conduct a stress test of observability with 502 retrained models, finding that hidden embeddings reveal known deletions missed in predictions. To characterize capacity limits on coverage, we show that distinguishing all $n$ singleton deletions with linear scores can require a shared representation of rank $\Omega(\log n)$. translated_title: 关于机器遗忘中覆盖率评估的可观测性极限
translated_abstract: 机器遗忘旨在移除任意被请求的训练数据子集的影响，同时保留模型在剩余数据上的效用。现有实证评估通常通过模型输出或中间激活来衡量预测准确率并进行训练集成员推断（MIA）。然而，这些评估由于只聚焦于选定的遗忘集，可能忽视“覆盖率”——即一个方法所能满足的请求范围。为了评估这种覆盖率，我们首先利用502个重训练模型对可观测性进行了压力测试，发现隐藏嵌入能够揭示在预测中被遗漏的已知删除操作。为刻画覆盖率的容量极限，我们证明用线性分数区分所有n个单例删除可能需要秩为Ω(log n)的共享表示。我们进一步将该下界扩展到任意子集，并阐明了部分删除何时可能显得完全。基于这一分析，我们提出了CEO，一个用于评估机器遗忘覆盖率的框架。
tldr: 该研究通过502个重训练模型的可观测性压力测试和Ω(log n)秩下界的理论证明，揭示了现有机器遗忘评估因只关注特定遗忘集而忽视“覆盖率”的问题，并提出了评估遗忘覆盖率的CEO框架。
en_tdlr: Through observability stress tests with 502 retrained models and a theoretical Ω(log n) rank lower bound, this work reveals that existing machine unlearning evaluations overlook "coverage" by focusing on selected forget sets, and proposes CEO, a framework for evaluating unlearning coverage.
